capacity_gross_kwh.notes: electrive (US 2025): 105 kWh battery, up from 93.4, on all models. InsideEVs: 105 kWh gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: InsideEVs: 105 kWh gross, 97 kWh usable (2025 refresh).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the Audi e-tron GT 2025-2026 (S and RS performance) on the 105 kWh J1 pack: NMC 811, LG Energy Solution.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: same e-tron GT battery-preconditioning feature (2021 launch); nothing shows its removal for the 2025-2027 facelift; years compared 2022-2027.

dc_max_kw.notes: electrive: 320 kW peak, up from 270 (2025 US S e-tron GT and RS e-tron GT performance, 105 kWh battery on all models).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the only page is Audi's European launch page for the 93.4 kWh GT (11 kW standard); no page states AC power for the 105 kWh 2025+ GT, so the same-model-line charger is assumed although the pack changed. North America may be 9.6 kW as on the Q6/A6 (Cars.com, Wikipedia).

published_10_80_min.notes: electrive: about 18 minutes from 10 to 80 % "under ideal conditions" (2025 US e-tron GT).
